title: sec: NaN RF metrics cause non-deterministic root election
description: RootCandidate::cmp() uses partial_cmp().unwrap_or(Equal) for float comparison at line 762. NaN rssi_ema or snr_ema makes ordering non-deterministic. Use f32::total_cmp() or validate metrics are finite on ingestion.
close_reason: Already fixed: RootCandidate::cmp() at multi_instance.rs:901 uses f32::total_cmp() which properly handles NaN values with deterministic ordering
